notes: WArmy 0.4.37 — feat: plugin system aligned with the official DeepSeek Harness (dsh/Cordis) plugin model. (1) Deterministic, non-model-discretion extension points: plugins register ctx.on(event) listeners fired by the host at fixed lifecycle points (before-tool veto via bail, after-tool, plugin-loaded), ctx.effect() with disposers run on unload (no resource leaks), ctx.provide()/inject services, and ctx.middleware() pipelines — alongside model-callable defineTool tools. (2) Plugins decide whether they have settings: a Schemastery-style Config schema (string/number/integer/boolean/select, defaults, required, min/max, title/description) drives an optional settings form; plugins without Config show no settings. Saving re-applies config live and persists it. (3) Update mechanism: SemVer range compatibility (engines), recommended-version selection (highest compatible non-prerelease, else prerelease), update detection and one-click update. (4) Plugin market/discovery per the dsh index spec: per-profile index sources (http/https, no userinfo/fragment), strict index validation with JSON-path errors, fuzzy multilingual search, category/label/sort-key ordering (missing values last), install confirmation showing the npm/git source, and version-detail install. A new plugin panel (installed cards with enable/disable, settings, update, uninstall and visible extension-point chips; discovery tab) is wired into Settings. Verified with offline gates (runtime 13, extension 24, market 54, installer 11, planA 10, host 33) and a real-device probe (17 assertions) over the actual load/settings/toggle/market/update flow; changed-area gates passed three consecutive clean rounds. Carries all prior features unchanged.
